## About
Collie Autoworks is a family owned, independent Mercedes-Benz and BMW service center in San Rafael, Marin County. We also service all other German and European motor vehicles, and we care for classic German and European cars too.
Darren and Denise Collie and their staff treat your vehicle with the same care and respect you do. Darren is factory trained and certified to repair Mercedes-Benz, and our staff is Mercedes-Benz Master Certified and ASE Master Certified.
Our customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 76 Google reviews. Stop by the shop on Irwin Street or give us a call. We are glad to answer your questions.

## Services
- Mercedes-Benz and BMW service: Service and care for Mercedes-Benz and BMW vehicles.
- European car mechanical service: Mechanical work on all German and European motor cars, including classics.
- Brake repair and replacement: Brake repairs and replacement for German and European vehicles.
- Diagnostic and electrical service: Tracking down warning lights and electrical problems. One reviewer had an electrical problem on a Sprinter fixed here.
- Transmission repair: Transmission repair, overhaul or replacement.
- Air conditioning service: Keeping your car's air conditioning working the way it should.

## FAQ
Q: Which days is the workshop open?
A: The workshop is open Monday to Friday.

Q: Can I come in after hours?
A: Yes, after hours visits are available by appointment. Call us to set one up.

Q: Do you work on Sprinter and G-Wagen vehicles?
A: Yes. Along with Mercedes-Benz and BMW cars, we service G-Wagen and Sprinter vehicles.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We are on Irwin Street in San Rafael, near Highway 101.
